environment.materials: Two issued sales invoices and receivables from the invoice-task flow, plus one red invoice created through the page

replication.notes: RISEMAP current page is empty; title, periods, metrics, statuses, search, columns and empty state are observed, while row actions and same-material outcomes remain unavailable.

visual.notes: Populated desktop and 390x844 narrow views, status filtering, search empty state, reset and red-reversal dialog were checked in the built-in browser. Independent visual review remains pending.

interaction.notes: Forge filtering, required-field blocking, red reversal and cancellation passed. RISEMAP row-level behavior remains unavailable with the current empty account.

business.notes: Forge invoice, receivable, red invoice and reversal-log readback passed before and after same-SQLite restart. RISEMAP same-material business outcome remains unavailable.

requirements.steps: Open both current pages and inspect the four periods.
requirements.expected: Matching title, responsibility and period scope.
requirements.observed: Title responsibility and four period controls match the observed page structure.

requirements.steps: Compare UI metrics with line-derived tax and signed invoice totals before and after red reversal.
requirements.expected: Period metrics remain stable under local filters and match persisted amounts.
requirements.observed: 62000 before reversal and 26000 signed total after reversal; net and tax matched line-derived values.

requirements.steps: Switch statuses, search NO-MATCH and reset.
requirements.expected: Only rows and counts change while period metrics remain stable.
requirements.observed: Counts became all 3, normal 1, voided 0 and red 2; empty search and reset behaved correctly.

requirements.steps: Inspect all business columns against related records.
requirements.expected: Order, customer, email, project, amounts and tax resolve from actual data.
requirements.observed: Order, customer, amounts and tax resolved. Current materials have no contact email or project link, so those cells show an explicit dash.

requirements.steps: Open detail, submit empty reversal, complete reversal and attempt invalid repeats.
requirements.expected: Actions are reachable, invalid operations are blocked and successful reversal is readable.
requirements.observed: Forge paths passed; RISEMAP row behavior remains unavailable.

requirements.steps: Check desktop and 390x844 built-in-browser views with data, empty search and dialog.
requirements.expected: Usable first screen without page-level overflow; wide table scrolls inside its card.
requirements.observed: Desktop and narrow views passed, including the standard date input and full red-reversal dialog.

requirements.steps: Read invoices, receivables, lines and reversal log, restart the same SQLite and read again.
requirements.expected: Source, status, signed amount and linkages remain consistent.
requirements.observed: Forge readback passed before and after restart; RISEMAP same-material outcome remains unavailable.
